project.description: GCP project name used by default for all resources

destination.description: Repository reference to the source image that you wish to mirror

id.description: Repository reference for the mirrored image in the destination, referenced by the image digest, rather than the tag.

kms_key_id.description: GCP KMS key resource ID used to cosign the image after it is mirrored, e.g. `projects/my-project/locations/global/keyRings/my-ring/cryptoKeys/my-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1`. Optional.

source.description: Repository reference to the source image you wish to mirror

source_digest.description: Digest of the source image; should always match the digest of the destination image

block.description: Resource to import and sync images from public container registries into your ownGoogle Container Registries (GCR) or Google Artifact Registries (GAR).

project.description: Name of the GCP project to fetch conditional bindings for. If not specified, the provider-level project will be used.

role.description: Role to filter conditional bindings by

block.description:
Get all conditional bindings contained in a project level IAM policy.

Use this data source to get all the conditional bindings in your project level IAM policy, these conditional bindings can often be managed by third party tooling outside of Terraform. These bindings can then be added to a `google_project_iam_policy` resource.

access_policies.description: Indicates if the user has access to switch access context policies from enforce to dry-run mode.

escalations.description: Map of projects to escalation roles for each user. The key is the user email and the value is a map of project names to escalation roles.

iam_path.description: Path to the root of the IAM directory containing user and group definitions

user_email.description: Email of the user to filter escalations for. If not specified, all users' escalations will be returned.

block.description: Get all configured gsudo escalations for ravelin internal users.

project.description: Name of the GCP project to fetch service agents for. If not specified, the provider-level project will be used.

service_agent_policy.description: IAM policy JSON encoded as a string of all service agent bindings

block.description:
Get all service agents contained in a project level IAM policy.

Use this data source to get all the google managed service accounts (service agents)that have role bindings in your project level IAM policy. These bindings can then beadded to a `google_project_iam_policy` resource.

iam_path.description: Path to the root of the IAM directory containing user and group definitions

twingate_access.description: Map of users to Twingate access. The key is the user email and the value is an object of Twingate access details.

user_email.description: Email of the user to retrieve twingate access for. If not specified, all users access is returned.

block.description: Get all twingate access for ravelin internal users.
